body:
It's by design:

> redirection of all marketing urls to /docs in archive and next mode
> - the marketing pages are irrelevant in the next and archived mode and it's more appropriate to just redirect the visitor to the actual documentation)
> - the redirection should happen via Location service (using history.replaceState) so that we don't interfere with the critical path for TTI and don't need to maintain special firebase hosting config for various environments.

See https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/18287 for more information.

@IgorMinar, @petebacondarwin, is there anything actionable here. The current behavior is by design.
(Although, I am not sure why `next.angular.io` should redirect non-docs pages; usually the info will be up-to-date. Should we change that, so that only archived versions redirect?)
I agree that we should not need to redirect anything on next.angular.io, IMO. Over to @IgorMinar and @juleskremer ...

body: @petebacondarwin these redirects were originally setup for "archive" mode and were not intended for the "next" mode. I'm fine disabling the redirects for next, as long as we still redirect when in archive mode (v2.angular.io, v4.angular.io, ...)
